summary: Mail from the API through an outbox: the message commits with the change that caused it, a named Cloud Task sends it once (the message id is Resend's idempotency key), a sweep catches stranded messages and purges bodies after retention, signed delivery events move messages forward only, and bounces and complaints suppress the address. Admin routes list failures and suppressions, retry, and lift.

namePrefix.label: Resource name prefix
namePrefix.help: Short, lower case, e.g. acme. Prefixes every resource, so two applications in one project do not collide.

mailFrom.label: Sender
mailFrom.help: Name and address mail is sent from, on a domain verified at Resend, e.g. Acme <no-reply@mail.acme.com>.

nextSteps: Resend: verify the sending domain, and create a sending-only API key
